सुखकर्ता दुखहर्ता, वार्ता विघ्नांची ।
नुरवी; पुरवी प्रेम, कृपा जयाची ।
सर्वांगी सुंदर, उटी शेंदुराची ।
कंठी झळके माळ, मुक्ताफळांची ॥१॥
जय देव, जय देव जय मंगलमूर्ती ।
दर्शनमात्रे मन कामना पूर्ती ॥धृ॥
रत्नखचित फरा, तुज गौरीकुमरा ।
चंदनाची उटी, कुमकुम केशरा ।
हिरेजडित मुकुट, शोभतो बरा ।
रुणझुणती नूपुरे, चरणी घागरिया ।
जय देव जय देव जय मंगलमूर्ती ॥२॥
लंबोदर पीतांबर, फणिवरबंधना ।
सरळ सोंड, वक्रतुंड त्रिनयना ।
दास रामाचा, वाट पाहे सदना ।
संकटी पावावे, निर्वाणी रक्षावे, सुरवरवंदना ।
जय देव जय देव, जय मंगलमूर्ती ।

सुखकर्ता दुखहर्ता चा अर्थ काय?
सुख देणारा, दुःख हरणारा, विघ्नांची वार्ताही न उरवणारा. सर्वांगावर शेंदुराची उटी, कंठात मोत्यांची माळ. जय देव मंगलमूर्ती — दर्शनानेच मनोकामना पूर्ण होते.

What does Sukhkarta Dukhharta mean?

Giver of joy, remover of sorrow — he leaves no trace of obstacles, and grants love and grace. His whole form is beautiful with vermilion paste; a string of pearls gleams at his throat. Victory to the Lord, victory to Mangalmurti — at the mere sight of him, the heart's desire is fulfilled.

Om, salutations to Ganapati. You alone are the manifest principle. You alone are the creator, the sustainer, the dissolver. You alone are truly all this Brahman. Explain the meaning of Ganapati Atharvashirsha.

Om, salutations to Ganapati. You alone are the manifest principle. You alone are the creator, the sustainer, the dissolver. You alone are truly all this Brahman. You are the Self, directly and eternally. I speak the cosmic order; I speak the truth. Protect me, protect the speaker, the listener, the giver, the sustainer, the pupil; protect me from behind, in front, from the north and south, from above and below — protect me from every side.

Recited daily by many Maharashtrian families, and especially during Ganeshotsav. Explain the meaning of Ganapati Atharvashirsha.

Om, salutations to Ganapati. You alone are the manifest principle. You alone are the creator, the sustainer, the dissolver. You alone are truly all this Brahman. You are the Self, directly and eternally. I speak the cosmic order; I speak the truth. Om, salutations to Ganapati. You alone are the manifest principle. You alone are the creator, the sustainer, the dissolver. You alone are truly all this Brahman. Bowing my head to Vinayaka, son of Gauri, the refuge of devotees, I remember him daily for long life and the fulfilment of desire and purpose. Whoever recites these twelve names at the three junctures of the day has no fear of obstacles.
